title: Smol Serafimz Official Wiki
intro: Welcome to the official Smol Serafimz Wiki. /n/nSmol Serafimz is a hobby project made by LordFluffs depicting cute and mischievous slice-of-life moments of the titular characters in a carefree world. It's presented in various mediums, though most commonly via a comic strip. /n/nThis wiki serves as a database that logs all notable lore and data from the franchise as it grows over time.
